title: [Bug][SubscriptionBilling] Assign Subscription Lines dialog does not identify the sales line it was opened for
summary: The Assign Subscription Lines dialog now clearly identifies which sales line it is opened for by displaying the line number and description in its caption, and consolidates subscription package assignment logic to prevent duplicate dialogs when exploding bill-of-materials.
key_points: Dialog caption now shows sales line number and description instead of subscription package code
Subscription package assignment logic consolidated from two separate paths to one post-insert subscriber
Prevents duplicate dialogs when exploding BOM with multiple components
New extension event OnAfterGetAssignSubscriptionLinesCaption allows customization
Fixes a latent defect where lines were committed before their parent sales line was inserted
quote: The Assign Subscription Lines page gave the user no way to tell which sales line it was opened for.
